## Post to LinkedIn

### How it works

1. Runs when you click Execute Workflow.
2. Publishes a post to LinkedIn via the SocialRobot API.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node and connect your SocialRobot API credential (API key: socialrobot.io, Scheduler -> API Keys).
- [ ] Select your LinkedIn account in the Publish to LinkedIn node.
- [ ] Replace the example caption in the Publish to LinkedIn node with your own text.

### Customization

Replace the example content, then run the workflow whenever you want to post. Run it any time to post, or connect a Schedule Trigger to automate it. Everything runs inside your own n8n workspace, so you can change any step after import. Run it once with a test post to confirm every node behaves as expected before you rely on it.

## Publish to LinkedIn

Publishes the content to LinkedIn.

parameters.caption: We just automated our social media publishing end to end. What used to take an hour a day now takes one workflow. How much time do you spend scheduling posts?
